commit_subject: fix(sync): the Job Tracker and board pages show the résumés' cloud icon — a sync error or a refused sync is no longer only in the console (RES-R2-140-c)
commit_body:
Cause: useCollectionSync gave the jobs' and boards' engine only a `held` report, so every status it reports (syncing, synced, offline, error, stopped, off) went nowhere; a failed or refused sync was logged to the console only, and the workspace pages have no AuthBar.

Fix: collectionSyncMeta.js gains a status store (collectionSyncStatus: { jobs, boards } → { status, at }), collectionReport(name) (the report the hook now hands the engine: status and held both go to their stores) and worstSyncStatus (the worst of the lists shown: error, stopped, off, offline, syncing, synced). AuthBar exports its SyncDot, with an optional heldLabel for the 'stopped' words. The workspace's TopBar shows it (shell/CollectionSyncDot.jsx), between the search and the shortcuts help: on the Job Tracker's pages over the jobs and the projects (the sidebar lists the projects), elsewhere over the projects; nothing while signed out. Same icon, colours and words as the résumés'.

Test: tests/unit/collection-sync-status.unit.mjs runs the jobs' engine over the fake Firestore with collectionReport and checks the store (syncing → synced with a time, off when the rules refuse, error when the server is unavailable, idle signed out), checks the worst-status ranking, and mounts the TopBar at /jobs and /boards/b1 to read the icon's words (error, synced, off, offline, a held project named, none signed out).
notes: Confirmed at d11d5a0: useCollectionSync.js passed report: { held } only; the engine's status() calls (collectionSyncEngine.js 128-187) reached nothing, and AuthBar (the only sync icon) is not on the workspace pages. Product calls made: (1) one dot in the workspace TopBar's right group (before the ? help), the same SyncDot component so look, colours and words match the résumé dot; (2) lists shown = jobs + boards on /jobs* (the sidebar and search show projects there too), boards only on every other workspace page; (3) ranking error > stopped > off > offline > syncing > synced > idle (stopped, i.e. an item held back, counts with error since it is also red in the résumé dot); 'Synced HH:MM' uses the latest time of the lists; (4) 'stopped' words for jobs/boards: '“<name>” not synced (too large?) — saved in this browser', 'N jobs/projects/items not synced (too large?) …', or 'Sync stopped — saved in this browser' (the résumé words say 'large photo', wrong here). SyncHeldNotice stays as is. Stacked on RES-R2-140-a (it touches collectionSyncMeta.js and the same doc paragraph). docs/knowledge/05-state-auth-sync.md jobs-and-boards paragraph updated. No a11y changes beyond what SyncDot already has.
reviewed: Bug confirmed at d11d5a0 (useCollectionSync passed report {held} only; engine status() reached nothing; no AuthBar on workspace routes). Traced: hooks mounted once in App so both lists always report; failureReport maps permission-denied->off, unavailable->error; SyncDot default heldLabel keeps AuthBar/75-sync-status-tap/89 unchanged; idle store -> no dot so ui-shell and cypress SYNC_STATUS (dashboard only) unaffected; the SSR loader shares one collectionSyncMeta instance with TopBar. New test fails without src (missing exports, no dot) and passes with it (syncing->synced, off, error, ranking, /jobs vs /boards/b1 labels, held name, none signed out). Patch applies cleanly on d11d5a0 after RES-R2-140-a. No a11y/locale/tracking edits; subject says what the user sees.
